content: Section 10 of the Cardiovascular Disease and Risk Management: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2024 provides detailed guidelines and recommendations for the prevention, diagnosis, and management of cardiovascular disease (CVD) in individuals with diabetes. It emphasizes the importance of addressing cardiovascular risk factors, such as hypertension, dyslipidemia, and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD), in the context of diabetes care. The section outlines evidence-based strategies for optimizing cardiovascular health, including pharmacologic and non-pharmacologic interventions, and highlights the role of individualized treatment plans to achieve optimal outcomes.
